task.title: Find a person
task.shortdesc: Search your tree by a name, a place or an event, or list everyone, then open the person you want.

context.p: The search also looks at the other names a person has, so a pen name finds the person too. It searches the tree that is open.

step.cmd: Type a name, a place or an event in the search box.

info.p: For example, type Currer to find Charlotte Brontë by her pen name.

stepresult.p: The results come in one list. The people come first. The events come after them. A badge on each person, such as Sources: 0, says how many sources back that person up.

step.cmd: Choose the card of the person you want.

stepresult.p: The page of that person opens. Their name shows in the chip that starts with .

result.p: Now , and all show that person.
Three buttons above the cards show everything, only the people, or only the events. To see everyone without a search, choose on . The list gives each person's name, years, sources and events.
To narrow the results, choose . Tick , , or to add a filter. Tick to also find names that sound alike. Choose to start again.
